items.title: Get more from your Kiro investment with credit pooling: A guide for admins
items.summary: Kiro credit pooling gives admins new decisions: how many seats to keep, how many credits to buy, and what per-user limits to set. This hands-on guide shows how to size your pool and set limits from your own Kiro user activity reports using Amazon Athena, plus best practices for governing shared usage.
items.creator: Kirankumar Chandrashekar
